found_at: https://www.bill.com/ (navbar 'bill-logo w-nav-brand' ; the current file's recorded source). The same drawing is the logo on BILL's sign-in page, https://login.us.bill.com/Login (data-URI svg, kept as downloads/bill/src5/login-dataimg-0.svg).
edits: kept the 'b' and its light-orange flag (elements 0 and 4), removed 'ill' (elements 1, 2, 3 and the i's dot, element 5)
cropped the viewBox with a 2% pad
notes: BILL publishes its 'b' mark separately only as PNG (and in a Lingo press kit, bill.lingoapp.com/s/Press-Kit-oJKrzm, whose files need an API token to list), so the vector is the b cut out of BILL's own wordmark SVG; it is the same drawing as the PNG mark. Its favicon puts the b in white on an orange tile; I shipped the plain orange b, which reads on both themes. The mark is tall (0.59:1).
